title: Integrable inverse powers of the Euclidean bracket
statement: Use $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field]. Let $m\geq1$ be an integer and equip $\mathbf R^m$ with its Euclidean norm and Lebesgue measure. For every real number $s>m/2$, the continuous nonnegative function $$\xi\longmapsto(1+\|\xi\|^2)^{-s}$$ is Lebesgue integrable, that is, its integral over $\mathbf R^m$ is finite.
